back_sample.translation: This is a permanent, restricted DDL change assistant, not a database connection or transfer runner. External keys, CHECK presses, tables, comments, unwritten types and speaker-specific descriptions are not changed. Review and test the generated description on your database machine; monitor before applying schema changes.

raw_translation: ይህ ቋሚ, የተገደበ DDL ለውጥ ረዳት ነው, አይደለም የዳታቤዝ ግንኙነት ወይም ማስተላለፍ ሩነር. የውጭ ቁልፎች, CHECK ጫናዎች, ሰንጠረዦች, አስተያየቶች, ያልተጻፈ ዓይነት እና ተናጋሪ-ተለይተው መግለጫዎች አይደሉም የተቀየረ. ተመልከት እና የተፈጠረውን መግለጫ በዳታቤዝ ማሽንዎ ላይ ይሞከሩ; ስኪማ ለውጦችን ከመተግበርዎ በፊት መከታተያ ያድርጉ.
source: This is a static, restricted DDL conversion helper, not a database connection or migration runner. Review and test the generated statement against your database engine; keep a backup before applying schema changes.
